# Competitor Intelligence Automation Kit

> Evidence-first Python software for structuring competitor and pricing research.

FAQ:
https://sarvaiyaharsh30-eng.github.io/competitor-intelligence-automation-kit/faq.html

Core capabilities:
- normalize structured competitor research
- generate competitor comparison matrices
- preserve source provenance
- organize observed pricing information
- generate executive Markdown briefs

Important:
Public examples are synthetic.
Missing facts are not fabricated.
